prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite master for BILGEBOX, an original hand-painted fantasy MMORPG television casing in the Forever-Fone style.
Input image: reference image only, existing golden TV art. Paint a NEW neatly organized sprite sheet of THREE separate mechanical controls on genuine transparent background. Square image, orthographic perfectly front-facing, no perspective.
Layout: upper-left quadrant contains a complete round golden brass rotary TUNE knob with a broad circular mounting ring, all its edges visible, generous transparent margin. Its large raised ivory-brass pointer points to 10 o'clock. Upper-right quadrant contains the SAME knob and mounting ring, same scale, illumination, decoration and alignment, but the pointer points to 2 o'clock. The two knobs must be fully circular, not oval, with no labels and no lettering.
Lower-left quadrant contains a compact upright POWER toggle switch in a rounded rectangular golden brass mounting plate with two screw heads, copper lever pointing upward and dark recessed slot. No letters.
Lower-right quadrant contains a small brass resize crank: a complete circular screw hub, short diagonal brass arm running down-right, and a chunky copper handgrip, all within its quadrant with generous transparent margins.
Style: match the reference's rich hammered polished aged golden brass and copper, sculpted bevels, restrained dark brown crevices, warm yellow highlights, slightly handmade painterly relief, upper-left lighting. Each sprite must be separate, no background plates connecting quadrants. No text, no numbers, no logos, no watermark. No green, cyan or magenta. Original art.
reproducibility: The saved RGBA master is the deterministic input to make-art.py.
